Shipping Policy

Processing Time

1-3 business days after order confirmation.

Delivery Time

3-7 business days across India (PAN India shipping).

Shipping Charges

Free shipping on orders above ₹999. Standard shipping charges apply below ₹999.

Tracking

A tracking number is provided via email/SMS once your order is dispatched. Use our Track Order page to check status.

Delays

Delays may occur during festivals, sale periods, or due to courier issues. We will keep you informed.
